readPolicy.scope: One aggregate Rust executor callback, not a whole Native operation

proof: Queries read the exact Rust callback candidate; no committed-state lookup or document-version cache
Seven entity kinds and ownership, Core-only root, lazy metadata and reused within-callback index
Independent ownership assertions cover differently ordered measure definitions and measure contents
Lossless UTF-16, negative zero and marker-like ordinary keys survive replies
A valid 256-measure Rust fixture returns its last actual note in fewer than 512 bytes; not the 1024-note Wasm workload
Same-version prepare reads C, transform reads D, and the captured history journey retains exact outputs
A swallowed query limit after an effective Batch prefix rejects without document/history/dirty/event adoption; the next operation recovers
Detached migration reads have null version; swallowed failures at either callback phase reject without returning a migrated document
